bullets.title: AVGO posts record-worst earnings reaction day despite sixth consecutive triple play
bullets.body: Broadcom fell ~15% — its worst earnings reaction day in company history — after Q3 AI revenue guidance of $16B missed the ~$17.2B consensus, despite beating on revenue and EPS for a sixth straight quarter. Bloomberg Intelligence noted recent wins with Google, Meta, and Anthropic 'did not meet elevated market expectations.' Analyst Harlan's $300B AI revenue call for 2028 remains on the table but the stock was barely holding $400 intraday.

bullets.title: NVDA's Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics enters production; $2B investments each in COHR and LITE counter CPO cannibalization fears
bullets.body: NVIDIA invested $2B each in Coherent and Lumentum as suppliers on the Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics supply chain, which entered production May 31. The market had read co-packaged optics (CPO) as a death-knell for pluggable transceivers, but NVDA's actions suggest pluggables remain central. LITE was still down on the session as AVGO's TPU/custom ASIC commentary created conflicting read-throughs.

bullets.title: NVDA launches Nemotron 3 Ultra: 5x faster inference, 30% lower cost; DGX Spark boosts agentic workflows 2.6x
bullets.body: NVIDIA officially introduced Nemotron 3 Ultra at CVPR2026, targeting long-running agentic tasks with planning, reasoning, and tool-use — delivering up to 5x faster inference and 30% lower cost. Separately, DGX Spark updates via NemoClaw provide up to 2.6x inference speed gains for local agent workflows. The model was pre-trained in NVFP4 format, a signal for estimating future model sizes. NVIDIA also introduced composable physical AI workflows for autonomous vehicles and robotics at the same event.

bullets.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft jointly frame RTX Spark / AI PCs as GPU-first CUDA edge inference platforms
bullets.body: At Computex and Build, Microsoft and NVIDIA made a coordinated case for AI PCs evolving from modest NPU endpoints into high-memory, GPU-first, CUDA-capable local inference platforms — bullish for NVIDIA's edge AI adoption. The RTX Spark positioning reframes the AI PC category with implications for MSFT's Windows OS strategy, which is also reportedly re-emerging as a strategic priority.

bullets.title: CIEN drops ~20% despite beat-and-raise; AI networking capex cycle read-through still positive
bullets.body: Ciena reported its second earnings triple play in three quarters — Q2 2026 revenue beat with FY2026 guidance raised — yet shares fell as much as 16-20%. Analysts view the call as fundamentally bullish for the medium-term AI networking capex cycle, with the quarter 'strengthening 3 central investment debates.' Revenue grew 40% YoY driven by core Optical Networking. The sell-off is characterized as a 'fire sale' on a high-quality optical networking franchise.

bullets.title: META rallies 3.1% to session highs; LightShed disputes ad-delay reports
bullets.body: META shares extended to session highs, up 3.1%, during the afternoon session. LightShed Partners contradicted recent reports that META is delaying its ad push into non-IDFA iOS traffic, providing a potential catalyst for the move.

bullets.title: MRVL turns positive on SPY index inclusion speculation; $1T valuation cited as upside scenario
bullets.body: Marvell Technology went positive mid-session with market commentary suggesting traders are pricing in potential S&P 500 index addition, with substantial further upside if MRVL reaches a $1T market cap.

bullets.title: AMZN commits €10B+ to European fulfillment, deploys next-gen Proteus robots; OUST lidar is key supplier
bullets.body: Amazon announced a €10B+ investment to expand and modernize European fulfillment centers with next-generation Proteus robots for site-wide operations. OUST lidar sensors are embedded in the Proteus platform — driving a 9% intraday warrant rally for OUST while broader indexes were red. Amazon separately disclosed its Vulcan robot (first with tactile sensing) and reached 50,000 electric delivery vehicles globally.

bullets.title: RDDT: 69% YoY revenue growth, 91.5% gross margin praised as durable moat
bullets.body: Reddit's Q1 results drew attention on fintwit for 69% year-over-year revenue growth, 91.5% gross margin, and strong FCF generation. Commentary highlighted Reddit's data moat as durable against AI competition, calling it a 'massive earnings beat' with a 'strong network effect moat.'

bullets.title: TSLA: TD Cowen reiterates Buy at $490; Model Y L could add 60k–135k annual demand
bullets.body: TD Cowen reiterates a Buy rating on Tesla with a $490 price target, projecting the three-row Model Y L US launch could unlock 60,000–135,000 units of annual incremental demand, representing roughly 30% uplift over current Model Y volumes.

bullets.title: TSM praised for disciplined capacity management amid AI demand surge
bullets.body: TSMC management was described as 'tough, flinty, disciplined' in approach to capacity cycles, helping avoid overbuild and bubble dynamics. Separately, TSMC flagged it can only 'support so much' AI chip demand, signaling binding supply-side constraints in advanced node capacity.

bullets.title: AAPL's revamped Siri will rely on Google's NVDA chip infrastructure at September launch
bullets.body: Apple's overhauled Siri will depend on Google's NVIDIA chip infrastructure at its September release, creating an interplay between AAPL, GOOGL, and NVDA in the AI assistant stack. The App Store ecosystem separately hit $1.4 trillion.

bullets.title: PLTR partners with Google Cloud; IBM launches dedicated Google Cloud AI practice
bullets.body: Palantir announced a multi-tiered partnership with Google Cloud including platform integrations and Marketplace availability. Separately, IBM launched a dedicated Google Cloud Practice deploying thousands of certified consultants for enterprise AI scaling.

bullets.title: MU flagged as next AI infrastructure bottleneck; MicroLED optical interconnects emerging
bullets.body: A detailed thread argued the AI infrastructure bottleneck is shifting from GPU and HBM to MicroLED optical interconnects, where memory and optics converge. Micron, Samsung, and SK Hynix are all pursuing solutions. Representative Josh Gottheimer (House AI subcommittee) also filed purchases of SNDK, MU, and AMD.

bullets.title: Tech sector hits record 39.7% of S&P 500 — nearly 5 pts above dot-com peak; retail bullish options near records
bullets.body: The tech sector's weighting in the S&P 500 reached 39.7% on Tuesday, nearly 5 percentage points above the March 2000 peak. Separately, retail bullish trades make up nearly two-thirds of retail opening options activity in mega-cap tech stocks, approaching record optimism levels.

bullets.title: Fed speakers: Daly bullish on AI but sees no productivity data yet; Schmid says inflation still too high
bullets.body: Fed's Daly called herself 'bullish' on AI but said 2025 would be the litmus test, and that AI productivity gains 'have not yet been seen in data.' She added forward guidance is 'not good at this juncture' and policy is 'in a good place.' Schmid said 'inflation is too high' after a 'five-year fight' with no conclusion.

bullets.title: Labor market softening: jobless claims 225K (est. 215K), tech job cuts highest since Aug 2024; AI accounts for 88K YTD cuts
bullets.body: Initial jobless claims rose to 225K vs. 215K estimate and 212K prior. Tech sector job cut announcements hit their highest level since August 2024 in May. AI-related layoffs reached 88,000 YTD, already 60% above all of 2025, marking a third consecutive month as the top cause of job cuts. Q1 nonfarm productivity came in at just 0.3% annualized vs. 0.8% estimate.

bullets.title: IMF warns Fed to stay cautious; pushes 2% inflation target achievement to end-2027; oil reserves at 5-year low
bullets.body: The IMF advised the Fed to proceed cautiously citing higher tariffs and renewed energy price pressures, and delayed its 2% inflation timeline to end-2027 from mid-2027. It separately flagged Iran-related oil production disruption of 14M barrels/day, with global oil prices ~3% above April baseline, and reserves forecast to hit a 5-year low of 7.5B barrels in July.

bullets.title: Blackstone private credit fund gates redemptions at 5% amid 10% Q2 withdrawal requests
bullets.body: Blackstone's $79B private credit fund (BCRED) received redemption requests for nearly 10% of shares outstanding in Q2 and will fulfill only 5%. Multiple peers are taking similar defensive actions. The development signals meaningful liquidity stress in private credit markets.

bullets.title: Dow hits record high (+1.6%/+790pts); NASDAQ 100 down 1.3%; broad market rotation underway
bullets.body: The Dow Jones hit a record high, rising 1.6% or 790 points, while the NASDAQ 100 fell 1.3%, reflecting a sharp intraday rotation out of tech/semiconductors. The advance/decline line was on pace for its best reading in nearly two months (+297), and Goldman maintained its 12-month equity overweight stance, recommending buying dips as gains moderate.
